hero.tagline: Architectural Real Estate Advisory · Riviera Maya
hero.headline:
We Don't Just Find Paradise.
We Engineer Your Safety.
hero.subhead: Most agents just show you the view. We check the foundation, the permits, and the developer's track record. A boutique advisory for those who refuse to buy blindly.

team.title: Your Advocates in Paradise
team.subtitle: The Power of Dual Expertise
team.description: You need more than a salesperson. You need an advocate. We combine Marisol's technical architectural eye with Philipp's German precision in process management. We are your filter against bad investments.

marisol.name: Marisol Rosales Trujillo
marisol.description: Licensed Architect & Real Estate Advisor. Marisol sees what others miss: structural cracks, drainage issues, and permit irregularities. She fights for your interests in Spanish.

philipp.name: Philipp Hoffschröer
philipp.description: Your strategic partner. Philipp ensures your buying process follows European standards of clarity and communication. He translates 'Mexico' into a process you understand.

technical.title: Technical Audit
technical.description: We don't sell 'pretty'. We inspect construction quality, MEP systems, and structural integrity before you sign.

permits.title: Legal & Permit Verification
permits.description: We verify the developer's paperwork is actually in order. No 'pre-sale' promises—only facts.

foreigners.title: Native Communication
foreigners.description: We explain complex Mexican processes in clear English or German. No 'lost in translation' moments.

local.title: Insider Access
local.description: Based in Playa del Carmen, we know which developers deliver quality and which ones cut corners.

services.title: Comprehensive Advisory
services.subtitle: From Search to Keys
services.description: We are not volume sellers. We are bespoke advisors for a select group of clients.

foreignBuyers.title: Buying As A Foreigner
foreignBuyers.subtitle: Safe, Legal, Secure
foreignBuyers.description: Mexico is a safe place to invest—if you follow the rules. We guide you through the Fideicomiso, taxes, and closing with zero ambiguity.

fideicomiso.title: The Bank Trust (Fideicomiso)
fideicomiso.description: You fully own the property through a bank trust. It's safe, perpetual, and inheritable. We manage the setup.

taxes.title: Smart Tax Planning
taxes.description: We help you understand acquisition taxes (~3%) and property taxes (very low), and plan for capital gains efficiency.

process.title: The Closing Process
process.description: We coordinate the Notary, the Bank, and the Seller. We review every draft deed before you sign.

payments.title: Easy Global Payments
payments.description: Pay advisory fees in USD, EUR, or MXN. We use compliant international accounts to make your life easy.

tulum.name: Tulum
tulum.description: Eco-chic jungle luxury. High appreciation potential for carefully selected projects.

cancun.name: Cancún

origin.subtitle: The Truth
origin.title: Why We Created This Service
origin.content: This business wasn't started to sell houses. It was started because buying a house here was a nightmare. When Philipp moved to Mexico, he and Marisol tried to buy property. Even as an architect, Marisol was shocked by the lack of professionalism in the market: Agents who ghosted them. 'Luxury' condos with poor wiring. Hidden legal issues. They almost lost money on a bad deal.
origin.conclusion: We decided: 'Enough.' We built The Paradise Architect to be the service we wished we had. A service where an Architect protects your asset, and a European manages the process. No fluff. Just competence.

premium.title: The Premium Model
premium.subtitle: Serious Advisory for Serious Buyers
premium.description: Most agents establish no loyalty until they sell you something. We work differently. We represent YOU, not the seller.

items: Unbiased Market Scan (We search the WHOLE market, not just our listings)
Architectural Quality Report on shortlisted properties
Video-documented inspections if you are remote
Aggressive price negotiation using technical findings as leverage

promise.title: Our Promise
promise.content: If we don't find a property that passes our architectural standards, we will advise you NOT to buy. We protect your capital first.

fee.title: Engagement Fee
fee.description: We charge a deductible engagement fee to start work. This filters out window shoppers and allows us to work heavily on your behalf before you ever make an offer.
fee.note: 100% Credited towards your purchase at closing.
